title: Cap. 6 Arg. 8 Primo: Prosper—no Gospel calling where Mother Church has not regenerated
pass_a_gloss: Prosper acknowledges that the objection, That not all human beings are called to grace, can truly be said of all those to whom the sacrament of Christ's cross and the redemption of his blood has not become known. And Sentence 4 on the Chapters of the Gauls: We cannot say that there is a calling of grace where as yet there is no regeneration of Mother Church. Which things are to be noted in that place against those who, in order to defend their opinion of grace prepared and offered to all on account of Christ, imagine I know not what calling and sufficiency of grace in the midst of the darkness of paganism. We can say of those grown in age what Prosper said of little ones: Let them be proved called in some way, to whom neither the planter was able to preach, nor the irrigator able to help, Response to Objection 4.
pass_b_english: Prosper grants the objection that not all are called to grace, at least of everyone to whom Christ's cross and the redemption of his blood have never been made known. Sentence 4 on the Chapters of the Gauls: we cannot say there is a calling of grace where Mother Church has not yet regenerated anyone. That strikes those who, to keep grace prepared and offered to all because of Christ, invent some calling and enough-grace in the thick of pagan darkness. What Prosper said of little children we may say of adults: prove them called somehow, when neither planter could preach to them nor irrigator help them (Response to Objection 4).
source_text: Prosper objectionem, Quod non omnes homines vocentur ad gratiam, de illis omnibus vere dici posse agnoscit quibus sacramentum crucis Christi et redemtio sanguinis ejus non innotuit. Et Sentent. 4. super Capit. Gallor.: Non possumus dicere quod ibi sit gratiae vocatio, ubi matris Ecclesiae adhuc nulla est regeneratio. Quae loco animadvertenda sunt contra istos, qui, ut tueantur sententiam suam de gratia propter Christum omnibus parata et oblata, in mediis Paganismi tenebris nescio quam vocationem ac gratiae sufficientiam imaginantur. Nos, quod de parvulis dixit Prosper, id de natu grandioribus dicere possumus: Probentur aliquo modo vocati, quibus nec plantator praedicare, nec irrigator potuit subvenire, Resp. ad Obj. 4.
